name: Ningyuansaurus
isnote: Described as the most basal oviraptorosaur (Ji et al. 2012); the cited Wikipedia revision calls it only a pennaraptoran, as later analyses differ.
sum: Feathered pennaraptoran from the Yixian Formation of Liaoning, first described as the most basal oviraptorosaur.
holotype: The only specimen, from the Yixian Formation at Jianchang, western Liaoning; kept at the Confuciusornis Museum in Xingcheng.
biology: Had more teeth than advanced oviraptorosaurs, but fewer in the back of the upper jaw than most other theropods.
author: Ji et al. 2012

sources.text: Q. Ji, J.-c. Lü, and X.-f. Wei, X.-r. Wang. 2012. A new oviraptorosaur from the Yixian Formation of Jianching, western Liaoning Province, China. Geological Bulletin of China 31(12):2102-2107
